steps.name: Food for Mir (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Harmonia] in "Old Belos", then obtain <Special Stir-Fried Baby Octopus> from the restaurant in "Elias". Bring it to [Mir] in the "Burning City".

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you for agreeing to help, adventurer. I want to prepare some food for Mir. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Harmonia. Tell me about it.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If you've spoken with Mir, you'll know.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Mir is a Pluton dragon, but has a form close to a human's.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Born frail, Mir overcame that weakness with help from the Sisters and spirits, and began living in a new form.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The power Goddess Seres left in Xenadia was a blessing for Mir. With those mysterious abilities came a calling, which Mir accepted.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Speaking with spirits, receiving divine revelations, delivering messages... It's a great burden for someone so young, but Mir does it wonderfully.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: That's why I wanted to give a gift: Mir's favorite food.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, food made by a spirit! That sounds exciting!

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: But there's a small problem. I'm the Spirit King of Harmony and Stability. I can't leave this troubled Inner World to cook.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: And even if I made something, I don't think I could achieve the flavor Mir wants. I drink natural spiritual essence, but have never eaten prepared food.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, when all's said and done, you can't cook.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Getting something delicious is wiser than making something that tastes bad.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes. You understood quickly.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I'd like you to obtain some food for Mir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What would be good?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Mir once told me about passing a restaurant in Elias.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The food smelled wonderful. Mir wanted to try it, but said there was no time to go inside...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: But Mir wasn't actually busy. People's startled reactions to a form neither spirit, dragon, nor human were frightening.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I want to offer the food Mir couldn't try then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll get it. I know where the restaurant in Elias is.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: One plate would hardly satisfy Mir. Please bring two. I'm sure Mir will love it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it'll be enjoyed. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you. Take care.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! You startled me!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: What you're carrying is definitely...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Food from that restaurant in Elias!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I don't know the ingredients, but it's that delicious food! I heard it's expensive. How did you get it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that Harmonia asked you to bring food for Mir.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Lady Harmonia, sniff... What a relief you didn't cook it yourself...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Anyway, give it here. I want to eat!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It cooled a little on the way from Jiendia. It should still taste good.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It's cold? That's fine! The fire spirits can warm it up!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir calls a fire spirit and asks it to hold the plate of cooled food for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (The fire spirit holds the plate, then returns it to Mir.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Look! Piping hot again!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fire spirit isn't a microwave, you know...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I've heard Atlantis has those machines. Anyway, it's warm now! Let's eat!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir stuffs all the food into their mouth.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir's face twists into a grimace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does it taste bad? It looks perfectly cooked. I tried it, and there's nothing wrong. What's the matter?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Is this... baby octopus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Special Stir-Fried Baby Octopus.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: H-help me. Urgh.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Humanly speaking... no, spiritually... no, dragon-wise... Anyway! Baby octopuses are horrible!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I once received a revelation and went to deliver a message that a certain region needed putting in order...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: There was a horrible Octopus Alien there. 'Hey, you! Came to see me, baby? Careful not to fall for my gorgeous looks.' Ugh.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Imagine being trapped listening to that for days! And there were strange cats everywhere, too. It was mental torture.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Waaah... That octopus... Urgh. Just thinking about that smarminess makes me sick...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is a little smarmy, but enough to make Mir refuse food...? Just how much did he torment you?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: ...I'll eat anything else you bring. Just get that octopus away from me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Hmm. Is that the end of this? It doesn't feel right...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hate octopuses... Disgusting. Drop dead... You sea squirt, sea cucumber, anemone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Collapsing in the middle of a meal is serious... I'd better discuss this with Harmonia. I can't leave the job half done...

steps.name: Food for Mir (3)
steps.objective: Talk to "a certain priest" in one of the rooms in the "Xenadia Surface Garden".

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Adventurer? You don't look happy. Has something happened to Mir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that eating stir-fried octopus reminded Mir of being tormented by the Octopus Alien.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: What an interesting person. But if Mir suffered so much, he must have gone too far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Far too far.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Have you met him, too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, briefly. He's from another planet, and seems to imitate someone I knew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, Siam... What happened to Siam? I feel like I'm forgetting something...)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: What are you thinking about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, my mind wandered for a moment.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Though Mir is a spirit, half is still a living creature. A little rest would help.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I'm sorry to ask you to go to more trouble... I only wanted to do something nice for Mir...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mir will understand. What should we do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't think of anything quite as fancy as that special stir-fried octopus...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I've heard humans long for food from home. Lady Iris also wanted a good meal in Belos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Mir's home would be...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Xenadia Gardens. A place divided between land and water.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Would you go there for Mir and me, adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can, but who should I ask?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: There's a priest who helped when young Mir's light of life was fading. I don't know the name, but they live in a place called the 'Chamber of Healing.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Food for Mir (4)
steps.objective: Obtain "Xenadia New Potatoes" and "Xenadia Sweet Potatoes", then report to [Mir] in the "Burning City".

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: A familiar adventurer. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Me?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Don't you remember me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well... I feel like I do, and also like I don't...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Never mind. That isn't important now.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard Mir grew up here.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: You know Mir?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. We met when...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain meeting Mir during your visits to Iris's Inner World.)

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: To think she would be the goddess... I must tell the priests and Sisters immediately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious. If Iris became a goddess, shouldn't the priests and Sisters know naturally?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: You may not know this, but time flows differently in Xenadia, as does the perception of space.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Just as the world cannot know everything about this place, this place cannot know everything about the world.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: The goddess doesn't yet fully control her power. That may be why we haven't perceived her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Anyway, this isn't the time for that explanation. Food Mir would like...? No need to think too hard.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: That child just needs plenty to eat. The place is full of favorite foods. Take all you like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is the food? All I see are buildings and rocks...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: The underground garden has plenty of potatoes and sweet potatoes. Dig some up and take them to Mir.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: With all those blessings from the goddess and spirits, raw ingredients will be fine. Mir can boil or roast them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will that be enough?

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Just saying you came to Xenadia for Mir will be enough to bring joy. That child treasures anyone who cares.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you, Priest. I feel I should give you something...

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: You've got something that smells delicious. Is it jerky?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this is jerky from Lumen.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Could I have a few pieces? Hmm... Delicious. Chew, chew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But you're already eating it... Sigh. All right, take it all. Thank you, anyway.

lines.speaker: 신관 크라토스
lines.text: Think nothing of it. See you again. Chew, chew... This is excellent jerky. Chew, chew.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hate octopuses... Filthy, foul, disgusting... Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still like that? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm fine, adventurer...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're still not feeling well.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I'm fine. Food will fix me right up. As long as it isn't octopus.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why I brought food.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh, these are...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Potatoes and sweet potatoes... Hmm. They smell of water. You brought them from there.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Xenadia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It brought back memories of living there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sad memories?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: No. I was always happy. Everyone cared for me so warmly.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Though the priests' cooking didn't taste good... They have dragon tastes, so they mostly ate things raw.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: My palate is more sensitive than a human's, I suppose. That may be why I eat so much.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Carrying all of that must have been heavy. Give it here. I'll eat it all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can eat it just like that? Without cooking?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Of course not. The fire and water spirits here will help.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (The fire and water spirits struggle to carry away the potatoes and sweet potatoes.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: What should we make? We have cheese, so let's make gratin! Fire and water spirits, please!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Asking spirits to cook... Definitely unusual.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Here, adventurer! Have a cheese and potato gratin before you go. The rest are mine, so hands off.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir looks satisfied at the dozens of plates of cheese and potato gratin.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Enjoy your meal. And be good to Lady Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hehe. Of course! And adventurer... I'm counting on you from now on, too.
